content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: sudden spike in 5xx rate for /v1/generate in us-west-2. current 5xx ~11.8% over baseline. paging: @maria (oncall). dashboard: https://metrics.redwood.internal/alerts/1786420123
maria (oncall): oncall ack. pulling traces + router logs now.
alyssa-sre: batcher metrics show rapid queue accumulation starting ~00:42 UTC. batcher.queue.length jumped ~50 -> 920 within 2.5m. head-of-line visible on pool-3 workers.
jason-runtime: gateway logs show upstream 504s and intermittent 502s into runtime. runtime side: repeated "dispatch timeout" and "kvcache pin eviction" spam.
raman-batcher: digging in: many long-lived streaming sessions holding KV handles. continuous batching window 50ms -> bunching up; a few streams preventing batch head from progressing.
luis-support: receiving customer reports: org-alpha seeing bursts of 504s, org-beta reporting degraded streaming. Support escalated SLA note for org-alpha.
kate-pm: need concise customer-impact summary and mitigation plan. which routes/pools?
maria (oncall): region us-west-2, route default (hosted). pool-3 appears to be hot. high-traffic streaming customers hit hardest.
alyssa-sre: quick mitigation proposed: 1) shrink batch-window pool-3 -> 8ms, 2) enable small-batch fast-path to bypass batching when backlog > threshold, 3) apply ingress throttling for anonymous/free traffic to preserve capacity for paid traffic.
jason-runtime: also propose temporary model-variant fallback to reduced-context/quantized variant for 60s to lower KV pressure. will trade slight quality for throughput.
raman-batcher: commands (ready):
```
redwoodctl runtime update-pool --pool pool-3 --batch-window-ms 8
redwoodctl runtime update-pool --pool pool-3 --enable-small-batch true
```
maria (oncall): initiating batch-window change now.
ops-bot: job started: update-pool/pool-3-batch-window (job-id: jb-12981). rolling patch to runtime replicas.
jason-runtime: launching variant fallback:
```
redwoodctl rollout model-variant --route default --variant low-kv --duration 60
```
alyssa-sre: applying anonymous throttle to 60rps to shed low-priority traffic while we stabilize.
raman-batcher: note: autoscaler is at allocation cap for pool-3; even if we scale, HOL might persist while long streams hold KV. small-batch fallback is highest immediate ROI.
infra-admin: received infra request to allow burst capacity for pool-3. approving temporary +8 replicas while we mitigate.
ops-bot: scale job started: scale pool-3 +8 replicas (job-id: jb-12982).
maria (oncall): after batch-window reduction + small-batch enabled: queue depth fell 920 -> 210 within 45s. 5xx down 11.8% -> 3.8%.
luis-support: customers seeing improvement. org-alpha reports initial recovery; org-beta still sees elevated p95 but no 504s now. Support keeping customer comm open.
kate-pm: good. capture all decisions on incident page /incidents/1786420123 for postmortem. note: check for recent client-side changes that could cause large number of long-lived streams.
raman-batcher: no config flips recently. early signal points to traffic shape change—clients opening many long streaming sessions with low token throughput which pins KV. collecting client-id histograms.
jason-runtime: observed several worker pods with dispatchLoop stuck on long requests; restarting stuck pods restores capacity. autoscaler couldn't add more because pool at cap. we've allowed burst so scaling should help.
alyssa-sre: monitoring now: 10m after mitigations 5xx ~0.9%, p95 latency improved 4.6s -> 2.1s, queue depth stable ~18.
maria (oncall): handing off to morning oncall @jason-runtime. handoff notes: small-batch fallback ON, batch-window=8ms, anonymous throttle=60rps, pool-3 +8 replicas. watch for reversion criteria: stable 5xx <1% for 30m.
jason-runtime: ack. I will own the rollback plan and runbook updates. setting reminder for 25m to reassess.
alyssa-sre: post-incident follow-ups: add HOL early-warning alert (tail-to-head queue skew), KV pin telemetry per-session, rate-limit long lived streaming sessions, improve autoscaler headroom signaling for pool caps.
kate-pm: action items: ram+alyssa lead RCA, maria+jason update runbooks, support handle customer follow-ups.
incident-bot: status -> mitigated, paging cleared for @maria (oncall). incident page: https://incidents.redwood.internal/1786420123
maria (oncall): thanks all. will append final notes and timeline to incident doc before sign-off. :white_check_mark:
